source_access: Public release/distribution unlimited;credit HYCOM Consortium,NRL,COAPS-FSU;actual returned attributes retained.
horizontal_support_policy: Retain all40 section/date cases,all candidate scores/local maxima,no-selection,gate/support-edge and primary-censored cases. No post-result tuning or unsupported continuity/occupation claims. Coastal dry/slope support,ice-masked fields and out-of-gate branches may censor;geographic maxima may be neighboring/mesoscale flow.
vertical_operator: Frozen connected-layer tracing searches above/below each qualifying seed on full native0-5000m support using adjacent finite brackets. Keep upper/lower contours,statuses,supported reach and paired span distinct. Selection endpoints,historical water-mass bands or core/reach scales,instrument ranges,sills,bed and missing limits are not physical current boundaries. Same-sign deep flow can connect;model span is not physical thickness. No thermal/density/salinity classification is performed.
processing_policy: Cloud-only sequential full-section acquisition,selection,threshold diagnosis,audit and tests on one idle CPU. Local metadata/code/source-PDF review/hash retention only;no local ocean-field processing/tests or runtime/UI/browser/server/native/WASM work. Separate source chunks honor unchanged2.5MB file limits.
revision_context: New quarterly Mauritania poleward and Baffin southward partial regional sections. Reuse validated latitude-interval collector logic,audits,geometry,component rotation,connected layers and bounded transport in a new source wrapper. Older validated sources/helpers remain unchanged. Frames,intervals and cutoffs are current-specific;no positive surface gate or thermal classification.
geometry_provenance: OSW exploratory fixed-latitude windows: Mauritania17,17.5,18,18.5,19N/18.5-16W,including18N source context;Baffin74.5,73,71.5,70,68.5N with respectively78-71W,76-68W,73-66W,70-63W,67-60W gates. Gates/stops are editorial,not digitized axes,widths,errors or full-route bounds. Existing routes describe summer surface geography and are not assigned quarterly subsurface axes.
column_selector: Frozen complete finite signed interval integrals,positive integral and qualifying core,with fixed geographic frame held through depth. Mauritania50-300m/0degree northward/core>10cm/s;Baffin100-300m/180degree southward/core>5cm/s. No positive surface gate,relative surface comparison or thermal gate. Greatest eligible integral wins;first western native tie. Gate/support-edge winners remain unresolved without weaker interior replacement.5/10/20cm/s sensitivities have their own seed at the same selected column.
temperature_policy: No temperature field retrieval or gate for these cases. Only velocity dataset and coordinates used.
time_scope: March/June/September/December15,2022 00Z quarterly instantaneous probes. These are not seasonal means,annual envelopes,independent observed occupations or historical cruise/fjord replication. Local seasonal context and route layer conventions remain explicit.
transport_budget: Preflight all40targets from10sections times4exactdates before fields. Frozen3-150nativecolumns,40levels,20000pairs/patch,250000total and7MBdecoded caps remain. Retry only an exact failed component/hyperslab on actualNetCDFI/Ofailure,max3attempts with2/5secondbackoff,while reserving all future first attempts. Successful components are not replayed. Ledger counts requested/decoded values,not wire bytes or precision.

current:mauritanian.branch_scope: Partial17-19N/18.5-16W poleward Mauritania boundary-current context around18N. Klenz2018 proposes naming the poleward surface and undercurrent branches together. Winter upwelling can place the target below opposing equatorward surface flow;relaxation can bring it to the surface. Do not classify the equatorward Canary/coastal jet as the target or infer source water from velocity. Historical seasonal means,100-200m core band and250m reach are not2022 boundaries or annual limits. Fixed northward is not a curved alongshore axis. Existing summer surface route is not a winter/subsurface axis.

current:baffin.branch_scope: Partial western Baffin Bay74.5-68.5N external coastal/slope context,following the declared southward direction toward Davis Strait. Exclude northward West Greenland Current,Lancaster Sound intrusion,Arctic strait feeders,fjord circulation and southern Davis Strait continuation. Source Arctic-water100-300m band is a component context,not a full-current thickness or bottom;no temperature/salinity class is diagnosed. Fixed southward does not rotate along curved coastal axes. Existing summer near-surface route is not a quarterly subsurface trajectory. Ice/dry/slope support and eddies may censor or confound selection.
